{{Quote|Thank you for your counsel, Lady Rhea. I'm most grateful.|Axela Zin to Lady Olaris Rhea|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Axela Zin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] and a [[Sith Saber]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. She gave birth to one [[Axela Zin's son|son]], who had become a [[Sith Tyro]] by [[43 ABY]]. Zin was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] handpicked by [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] to search for [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], and hunt down [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. She was part of the search party who looked for Ship on [[Abeloth's planet|the planet]] to which the Sith tracked the Meditation Sphere, but she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when vines on the jungle world attacked her.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm sure I don't need to remind you to watch yourselves in this jungle. But if something ''does'' get you, die quietly. Your family will be rewarded if you do&mdash;and punished if you don't.|Lady Rhea to her handpicked search party|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Axela Zin was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the remote<ref name="Abyss" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. She was [[Sith training|trained]] in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on Kesh during the days of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. Zin completed her training with the Tribe and rose to the rank of [[Sith Saber]]. She also gave birth to a [[Axela Zin's son|boy]], who became a [[Sith Tyro]]<ref name="Abyss" /> by [[43 ABY]].<ref name="Date" />

In [[41 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], arrived on Kesh and began to assist the Tribe in the creation of a new [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]].<ref name="Abyss" /> Two years later in 43 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> shortly after [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] presence was felt by the Tribe, Ship abruptly left Kesh to follow a call in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> Zin was chosen by [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] to be a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] whose task it was to track Ship and hunt down Skywalker. Zin traveled with the strike team in the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Eternal Crusader]]'', and they followed Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. Once there, Zin was chosen to be a part of the search party to go planetside, while the ''Eternal Crusader'' remained in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] under the command of Sith Saber [[Baad Walusari]]. As the search for Ship began, Zin was almost instantly impaled by three thorned boughs. Zin freed herself with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], but was quickly ensnared by more vines and [[Death/Legends|killed]]. She died without making a sound of pain, however, and the expedition's commanders, Lady Rhea and [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]], decided to commend her son for her bravery.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Not a whimper. I believe her son is a Tyro.|Yuvar Xal to Lady Rhea, after Zin's death|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Axela Zin was exceptionally brave, as illustrated when she heeded Rhea's orders and remained calm and silent even as she was killed by the [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. Zin was commended for her honorable death, and Rhea decided that her son, at the time a Sith Tyro, would be given a Master upon their return to Kesh.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Ship obeys any Sith with a strong will. You all have that, or you wouldn't be here.|Lady Rhea, to Zin and the Sith strike team|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Zin was a Force-sensitive, trained in isolation on Kesh in the ways of the Sith.<ref name="Abyss" /> By 43 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> she had completed her training in the dark side and was granted the rank of Sith Saber. Zin was also known to be strong-willed, as this was one of the criteria for being chosen as a member of the Sith strike team sent after Ship.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Axela Zin was created by established ''[[Star Wars]]'' author [[Troy Denning]] for ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third installment in the nine-novel [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, released in [[2009]].<ref name="Abyss" />
